name: Sarvam-105B
description:
Here is how to read the Sarvam-105B config.json. The architecture class is SarvamMLAForCausalLM, which is the transformers (or equivalent) module that wires embeddings, attention, the MLP, and the language-modelling head that turns hidden states into next-token logits.

hidden_size is 4,096: that is the width of every residual stream vector. The embedding matrix is therefore 262,144 × 4,096: each token id owns a vector of that width.

num_attention_heads is 64, so each head sees 576 dimensions (4,096 / 64). The ratio test is hidden_size / num_attention_heads = 4096 / 64 = 576. 576 is a multiple of 32 (NVIDIA warp-friendly), and a multiple of 16 (Huawei cube-friendly). From this number alone you cannot name the training chip.

num_hidden_layers is 32: the stack is that many transformer blocks deep.

intermediate_size is 16,384. In a SwiGLU MLP this is the high-dimensional workspace: the 4,096-wide stream is projected up, activated with silu, then projected back. Labs usually round this width to a multiple of 128 or 256 so it tiles on the chip.

max_position_embeddings is 131,072 tokens — the context window in the config. rope_scaling is type deepseek_yarn with factor 40, which stretches the rotary positions so the advertised window can be larger than the span the model originally trained on. rope_theta is 10000.0: that is the wavelength of the rotary embedding. A larger theta keeps distant tokens from aliasing after a full rotation.

vocab_size is 262,144. 262,144 is divisible by 256, the usual vocab-tiling grain. bos/eos ids, when present, are just two special rows in that table; the padded vocab is often larger than the tokenizer’s real inventory.

This is a mixture of experts: 128 routed experts with top-k 8. The 1991 Jacobs / Jordan / Nowlan / Hinton paper “Adaptive Mixtures of Local Experts” is the ancestor of this router-plus-specialists idea.

tie_word_embeddings is false, so the input embedding matrix and the output LM head are separate learned matrices rather than a shared transpose.

torch_dtype is float32.

The copy of config.json is from https://huggingface.co/sarvamai/sarvam-105b/blob/main/config.json.
